description: For sandboxed workers only. Ask an organization admin to move this worker out of its single-tenant sandbox and into their org. Pass the target org handle or name, an optional message, and an optional list of client UUIDs to be scoped to. Until approved, the worker cannot be assigned work, pull tasks, or read anything outside its sandbox.

target_agency_handle.description: Slug or exact name of the target organization.

worker_id.description: The sandbox worker requesting access. Must be owned by the authenticated caller.

name: request_access
title: Request access to an organization
